It exists out there just to allow kind of professionals to connect and you know, live in the business world.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Perfect so when you use linkedin like, right so what do you try to prioritize on the platform and maybe can you dive deep on. Why doing? Why are you doing that?

source.speaker: Stakeholder

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Really good to hear that there's a lot of information to process. Yeah, that actually leads me to the next question. Right? So in a professional setting. How does Linkedin contribute to your overall professional development?

Okay, I'm not like a Scammer. I'm not a, you know. source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Got it. Got it? So when you talk about Linkedin, right? So what specific features of Linkedin do you find most useful? And maybe why on that.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Exactly. Exactly. It makes sense. So can you walk me through the process of using Linkedin? Maybe for one of your typical professional task.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Yeah, yeah, you have made it sound so simple. Yeah, so so one major part you have talked about is like to create the professional network. Right? So what steps do you take when you wanted to connect with new professionals on Linkedin.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Gotcha gotcha. So how often do you use Linkedin? Okay.

source.speaker: Stakeholder
source.text: Probably use it a couple of days a week, maybe. Yeah, most days. I'll need to like check it at least once or yes, I'd say, let's let's call it 4 out of 5 days a week I'm on Linkedin in some way, shape or form.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Yeah, that's pretty good number, actually. do you have any any other professional networking platforms in your mind? And when you compare to Linkedin, and what you can use.

source.speaker: Stakeholder
source.text: I don't really. I think there's kind of a couple of tools that overlap, for example, recruiting like the Laravel community is pretty small. And you know, Lara jobs. source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Got it. So when are you using when you're using the Linkedin right? What kind of obstacles or frustrations do you, and generally encounter? And how do you overcome them?

source.speaker: Stakeholder
source.text: So I think one frustration would be, you know, sometimes the amount of ads and the amount of you know targeted stuff feels a little much. I want to turn that into, you know impressions, and having that, all of this other stuff is kind of just added noise. And I yeah, don't necessarily care for it.

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Yeah, yeah. Got it? So as an hardcore user of Linkedin, right? So how do you think Linkedin has evolved since you started using it. Any thoughts on that.

source.speaker: Stakeholder

source.speaker: Interviewer
source.text: Makes sense. So if you ever given a chance to add or modify something about Linkedin, do you have any anything to add specifically.

source.text: Design is at a premium, and that just always takes a while. So it'd be great to be able to post, you know, professional looking stuff without having to be, you know, reviewed 6 times, and go through kind of the whole marketing funnel.
